The user says their interface preference is dark theme, and asks me to remember it. Explicitly says do not call any tools, do not read files, answer directly.

So I should just acknowledge in Chinese. No tools. Note there's a memory aspect — but they said don't call tools. So just verbally acknowledge and note it's for this conversation / I can't persist beyond without tools. Be honest: within this session I'll keep it in mind; I have no persistent memory tool unless I write files (which they forbade). So state that honestly briefly.

Keep it short.
